{{External|rs=Slayer Masters}}
{{otheruses|the NPCs that give [[Slayer task]]s|the [[Grid Master]] unlock|Slayer Master (relic)|the term for a player with level 99 Slayer|Slayer cape}}[[File:Slayer Master icon.png|left]]
'''Slayer Masters''' are NPCs who serve as guides to the [[Slayer]] skill and assign tasks to players requiring them to kill specific monsters a certain number of times. Each Slayer Master has a different combat level requirement for players to be assigned tasks from them. Slayer Masters with higher combat level requirements will generally assign longer tasks with more difficult monsters.

Players receive [[Slayer reward point]]s upon completing [[Slayer task|tasks]] from most Slayer Masters{{Note|Tasks assigned by Spria and Turael never award any slayer points. Tasks assigned by Mortimer do not award any slayer points unless specified when receiving the task.}}, with [[Slayer reward point#Assignments|bonus points]] being awarded at regular intervals. These points can be redeemed at a Slayer Master for a variety of different [[Slayer Rewards|rewards]], including unlocks and upgrades which enhance a player's Slayer experience. This reward shop is accessed through the '''Rewards''' menu option.

All Slayer Masters also operate an [[Slayer Equipment (shop)|equipment shop]]. These shops sell [[Slayer equipment]] which are helpful and sometimes essential for completing specific slayer tasks. This equipment shop is accessed with the '''Trade''' menu option.

==Turael/Aya==
[[File:Turael chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=2932|y=3537|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Turael/Aya.|mtype=square}}
[[Turael]] gives the easiest Slayer tasks and is ideal for lower level players. They have no minimum combat or Slayer level requirements before players may receive assignments. After the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]], [[Aya]] replaces Turael as the Slayer Master.

Blocking a task with this master costs 40 Slayer points, and the block list is shared with [[Spria]].

If a player of any level receives an assignment they do not wish to do, Turael may consider giving players an easier assignment if they talk to him effectively "skipping" the hardest assignment. However, this only works if the assignment is something that he doesn't assign. For example, if Chaeldar assigns a player [[Desert Lizard]]s, then the Burthorpe Slayer Master cannot change their task, as he too assigns Desert Lizards.  Note that it is impossible for a player to get Turael to reassign a task that he gave out.

He is located in a small house south of the [[general store]] in [[Burthorpe]]. The fastest ways to reach him are to use:

*A [[Games necklace]] to the [[Burthorpe Games Room]], down the stairs and run east.
*A [[Combat bracelet]] to teleport to the [[Warriors' Guild]] and run east.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Turael '''will not''' grant any Slayer points. As well, if it was a task replacing one from another Master your [[Slayer reward point|task streak]] will be '''reset'''. So, if you're on the 48th task and take a replacement one from Turael, your completed tasks will be set to 0.

==Spria==
[[File:Spria chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=3092|y=3268|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Spria.|mtype=square}}
[[Spria]] is Turael's daughter, and has the same task list as him, in addition to assigning [[sourhog]]s. She plays a role in the quest [[A Porcine of Interest]].

Blocking a task with this master costs 40 Slayer points, and the block list is shared with [[Turael]]/[[Aya]].

She is located in a small house in [[Draynor Village]]. The fastest ways to reach her are to use:

*An [[amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]].
*An [[explorer's ring]] to teleport to the [[South Falador Farm]] and run south-east.
*A [[necklace of passage]] to the [[Wizards' Tower]] and run north.
*[[Lumbridge Teleport]] and run west.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Spria '''will not''' grant any Slayer points.

==Krystilia==
[[File:Krystilia chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=3110|y=3516|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Krystilia.|mtype=square}}
[[Krystilia]]'s tasks come with a risk: tasks assigned by her '''must''' be done within the [[Wilderness]]. She has no minimum combat or Slayer level requirements, and doesn't factor in the player's combat level, meaning she may give players tasks much harder than their combat level would otherwise indicate.

Blocking a task with this master costs 100 Slayer points.

While completing Krystilia's tasks, players may obtain [[Larran's key]]s, the drop rate of which is dependent on the monster's combat level. They can be used to open a [[Larran's small chest|small]] or [[Larran's big chest|big chest]] for additional rewards.

Assignments from her have a separate task completion counter than assignments from other Slayer Masters, so players will have to complete five of her Slayer assignments to begin earning Slayer reward points. If the player chooses to reset an assignment Krystilia gives before the five assignments are completed, the counter will reset to zero and the player will need to complete five more tasks before they will receive reward points.

She can be found by the jailhouse in [[Edgeville]], north-east of the bank. The fastest ways to reach her are to use:

*An [[amulet of glory]] teleport to Edgeville.
*The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DKR}}, and run west over the river.
*The [[Paddewwa Teleport]] from the [[Ancient Magicks|Ancient Spellbook]], then exit the dungeon and run north.
*One of the [[canoe]] spots on the [[River Lum]].
*[[Lesser Fanatic]] teleport on the  [[Achievement diary cape|Achievement Diary Cape]].

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Krystilia grants:

*25 points per task
*125 points for every 10th
*375 points for every 50th
*625 points for every 100th
*875 points for every 250th
*1,250 points for every 1,000th

==Mazchna/Achtryn==
[[File:Mazchna chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=3511|y=3509|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Mazchna/Achtryn.|mtype=square}}
[[Mazchna]] is the third easiest Slayer Master. The minimum combat level requirement to be assigned tasks from him is 20. During the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]], Mazchna is temporarily replaced by [[Achtryn]].

Blocking a task with this master costs 50 Slayer points.

Mazchna is located north-east of [[Canifis]]. The fastest ways to reach him are to use:

*The [[Kharyrll teleport]] from the [[Ancient Magicks|Ancient Spellbook]].
*The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|CKS}}, arriving west of Canifis.
*The [[Salve Graveyard Teleport]] or [[Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport]] from the [[Arceuus spellbook]].
*An [[Ectophial]] to arrive at the [[Ectofuntus]], and run west.
*The charter ship to [[Port Phasmatys]], and run west.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Mazchna grants:

*6 Slayer points per normal task<ref name=":0" />
*30 points for every 10th<ref name=":0" />
*90 points for every 50th<ref name=":0" />
*150 points for every 100th
*210 points for every 250th
*300 points for every 1,000th

==Vannaka==
[[File:Vannaka chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=3147|y=9914|plane=0|mapID=12|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Vannaka.|mtype=square}}
[[Vannaka]] is a mid-level Slayer Master. The minimum combat level requirement to be assigned tasks from Vannaka is 40. 

Blocking a task with this master costs 60 Slayer points.

He is located in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]], east of the [[Wilderness]] gate. The fastest ways to reach him are to use:

*[[Giantsoul amulet]] teleport to [[Bryophyta]], then run west and use the [[Obstacle pipe (Edgeville Dungeon)|obstacle pipe]] shortcut (Requires 51 [[Agility]]).
*An [[amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]], north of the dungeon entrance.
*The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DKR}}, arriving east of Edgeville.
*Using the [[Paddewwa Teleport]], teleporting you inside of the dungeon.
*Mini-game teleport to Soul Wars.
Note that if accessing Edgeville Dungeon through the entry west of the [[Cooks' Guild|cook's guild]], a [[brass key]] is required.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Vannaka grants:

*8 Slayer points per normal task<ref name=":0" />
*40 points for every 10th<ref name=":0" />
*120 points for every 50th<ref name=":0" />
*200 points per 100th
*280 points per 250th
*400 points per 1,000th

==Chaeldar==
[[File:Chaeldar chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=2444|y=4431|mapID=28|r=4|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Chaeldar.|mtype=square}}
[[Chaeldar]] is a mid-level Slayer Master. To be assigned monsters from her, you must have completed [[Lost City]] and have a minimum combat level of 70.

Blocking a task with this master costs 70 Slayer points.

She is located in [[Zanaris]] by the [[Fairy Queen|Fairy Queen's]] Throne. The only ways to reach her are to use any [[Fairy ring|fairy ring]] to go to Zanaris, or entering the shed in the [[Lumbridge Swamp]] whilst wielding a [[Dramen staff]] or [[Lunar staff]].

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Chaeldar grants:

*10 Slayer points per normal task
*50 points for every 10th
*150 points for every 50th
*250 points per 100th
*350 points per 250th
*500 points per 1,000th

==Konar quo Maten==
[[File:Konar quo Maten chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=1309|y=3785|plane=0|r=3|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Konar quo Maten.|mtype=square}}
[[Konar quo Maten]] is the fourth hardest Slayer Master. To receive [[Slayer task]]s from her, a [[combat level]] of 75 is required.

Konar is unique amongst the primary Slayer Masters in the fact that in addition to assigning a monster, she will also assign one of multiple locations (if the monster can be found in other places). She will never direct players into the Wilderness, unless it is part of boss Slayer, as that is Krystilia's assignment location.

While completing Konar's tasks, players may obtain a [[brimstone key]], which have drop rates similar to [[Larran's key]]s. They can be used to open the [[brimstone chest]] near her for additional rewards.

Blocking a task with this master costs 80 Slayer points.

She is located on the summit of [[Mount Karuulm]]. The fastest ways to reach the summit are to use:

*[[Rada's blessing 3]] or [[Rada's blessing 4|4]] to teleport to [[Mount Karuulm]].
*The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|CIR}}, arriving south of [[Mount Karuulm]].
*A [[skills necklace]] or [[Farming cape]] to teleport to the [[Farming Guild]] and run north-east.


===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Konar quo Maten grants:

*18 (20){{Refn|After completing the Elite [[Kourend & Kebos Diary]], players will have an increased number of points received per task.|name=Konar quo Maten|group=b}} Slayer points per normal task
*90 (100){{NamedRef|Konar quo Maten|group=b}} for every 10th
*270 (300){{NamedRef|Konar quo Maten|group=b}} for every 50th
*450 (500){{NamedRef|Konar quo Maten|group=b}} points per 100th task
*630 (700){{NamedRef|Konar quo Maten|group=b}} points per 250th task
*900 (1,000){{NamedRef|Konar quo Maten|group=b}} points per 1,000th task
{{Reflist|group=b}}

==Nieve/Steve==
[[File:Nieve_chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=2432|y=3424|r=2|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Nieve/Steve.|mtype=square}}
[[Nieve]] is the third hardest Slayer Master. The minimum combat level requirement to be assigned tasks from Nieve is 85. After the events of [[Monkey Madness II]], [[Steve]] replaces Nieve as the Slayer Master.

Blocking a task with this master costs 90 Slayer points.

She is located in the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]], near the yew trees and the southern bank. The fastest ways to reach her are to use:

*A [[Slayer ring]] teleport to the [[Stronghold Slayer Cave]].
*A charged [[Necklace of passage]] to [[Outpost|Jorral's Outpost]], then run north.
*The [[Balloon Transport System]] to the [[Grand Tree]].
*A [[Spirit tree]] to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and run south-west.
*A [[gnome glider]] to the Grand Tree and run south-west after leaving the grand tree.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Nieve grants:

*12 (15){{Refn|After completing the Elite [[Western Provinces Diary]], players will have an increased number of points received per task, equivalent to that of [[Duradel]].|name=Nieve/Steve|group=c}} Slayer points per normal task
*60 (75){{NamedRef|Nieve/Steve|group=c}} for every 10th
*180 (225){{NamedRef|Nieve/Steve|group=c}} for every 50th
*300 (375){{NamedRef|Nieve/Steve|group=c}} for every 100th
*420 (525){{NamedRef|Nieve/Steve|group=c}} for every 250th
*600 (750){{NamedRef|Nieve/Steve|group=c}} for every 1,000th
{{Reflist|group=c}}

==Duradel/Kuradal==
[[File:Duradel_chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Slayer Master|x=2869|y=2982|r=3|plane=1|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The location of Duradel/Kuradal.|mtype=square}}
[[Duradel]] is the second hardest Slayer Master. To be assigned tasks from Duradel, players must have a Slayer level of at least 50, and a combat level of at least 100. Also, to be able to enter [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]], where Duradel resides, players must have completed the [[Shilo Village]] quest. After the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]], [[Kuradal]] replaces Duradel as the Slayer Master.

Blocking a task with this master costs 100 Slayer points.

He is located on the platform bridging the river at the fishing shop in Shilo Village. Although Duradel is usually north of the river (or sometimes on the bridge), he cannot be accessed from north of the river. Instead, enter the fishing shop south of the river, climb the ladder there, and cross the bridge to get to him.

The fastest ways to reach Shilo Village are to use:

*[[Karamja gloves 4]] to teleport directly to Duradel.
*[[Karamja gloves 3]] to teleport to the [[Shilo Village mine]].
*The [[Shilo Village cart system]] to Shilo Village from the north end of [[Brimhaven]].
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|CKR}}, arriving west of Shilo Village.

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Duradel grants:

*15 Slayer points per normal task
*75 for every 10th
*225 for every 50th
*375 for every 100th
*525 for every 250th
*750 for every 1,000th

==Mortimer==
[[File:Mortimer chathead.png|left]]
[[Mortimer]] is the hardest Slayer Master. To be assigned tasks from Mortimer, players must have a Slayer level of at least 70, and a combat level of at least 100. Also, to be able to enter [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]], where Mortimer resides, players must have partially completed the [[Fallen From Grace]] quest.

Unlike other Slayer Masters, Mortimer offers a choice of tasks, with 2 offered initially, increasing to 3 after 50 tasks completed from him. His tasks exclusively focus on monsters with [[superior slayer monster|superior variants]] available.

Each task also has a modifier, with more possible modifiers unlocked after certain thresholds of tasks completed from him. The magnitude of a modifier varies depending on the monster assigned.

The following modifiers are available:
* Available after 0 tasks: Task awards [[Slayer reward point|Slayer Points]] on completion.
* Available after 0 tasks: Task quantity modified. Lower level monsters are reduced, and higher level monsters are increased.
* Available after 15 tasks: [[Clue scroll]] drop rates are increased.
* Available after 25 tasks: [[Superior slayer monster|Superior slayer creatures]] access the superior unique drop table more often.
* Available after 40 tasks: Slayer creatures award more Slayer experience.

Blocking a task with this master costs 120 Slayer points. Additionally, only 2 block slots are available, skips cost more (100 points), and tasks cannot be skipped by using [[Turael]].

As a result, Mortimer offers an alternative approach to popular Slayer methods that involve a heavy focus on skipping undesirable tasks; instead encouraging completion of less desirable tasks, in exchange for the bonuses provided by modifiers and his task list's focus on [[superior slayer monster]]s.

Mortimer is located next to Wyrmscraig Cavern's [[mooring point]]. The fastest ways to reach Mortimer are:

* [[Teleport to Boat]] can be used with a boat docked within the cavern, with a built [[greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]] boat facility, teleporting right next to Mortimer.
* A [[slayer ring]] can teleport to the northern end of the cavern, a short distance from Mortimer, after completion of [[Fallen From Grace]].
* Running to the cavern from a teleport to the surface of Wyrmscraig:
** [[Necklace of passage]]
** [[Ardeaglais teleport]]
** [[Teleport to Boat]]

===Slayer points===
Completion of a task assigned by Mortimer '''will not''' grant any Slayer points, unless a task with the slayer points modifier is chosen. 

Points granted by the modifier varies, being between 5 and 40 points, with higher level monsters offering more points. This amount is not increased by milestones, and tasks from him do not contribute towards the task completion counter at other Slayer Masters.

==Notes==
* Duradel/Kuradal and Mortimer are the only Slayer Masters with a Slayer level requirement, all other Masters can be utilised at Level 1 Slayer provided that the player has the appropriate [[Combat Level]] and meets any other requirements.
* Players can use the [[Lunar spell]] [[Astral Contact]] to receive a new task or updates on their current task from any Slayer Master, this is considered the most efficient way of receiving tasks as it does not require the player to travel to the appropriate Master.
* If a player becomes ineligible to receive their existing Slayer task, they can cancel it for free without losing their streak by speaking to a Slayer Master. Examples include:
** Turning off unlockable tasks such as [[Lizardmen]] or [[Basilisk]].
** Toggling off the setting for tasks to be given regardless of combat level, for tasks that would not otherwise be assigned at the player's combat level.

==Trivia==
* Nearly all Slayer Masters begin their conversations with "'ello" (the exceptions to this are Krystilia, Konar, and Mortimer). According to Mazchna, saying "'ello" is a tradition among Slayer Masters, but the reason why the tradition exists has been lost to time.{{CiteNPC|npc=Mazchna|quote=[Player: I guess so, though I have a question for you: Why do all Slayer Masters say 'ello so much?] Ah, it's somewhat of a tradition in our order. Perhaps there was once some reason, but it's long been lost to time.|loc=While Guthix Sleeps}}
* All Slayer Masters have the same examine text of "He/She looks dangerous!", or some variation of it.
** [[Camorra]], a hero from the [[Fourth Age]], has a very similar examine text, with it ending in a period instead of an exclamation point. Additionally, her [[Camorra (statue)|statue]] in ''RuneScape 3'' is depicted as wearing a [[slayer helmet]]. This possibly suggests that she may have been a Slayer Master herself.
